runs.below_target_definition: Feed below 80% of configured crusher capacity, including outages
runs.note: Synthetic controlled comparison. Both policies inherit the same trucks, material, road reservations and seed. Existing assignments finish before policy changes affect new decisions. Positive delta means adaptive minus rotation; lower grade error and waiting are preferable. No guaranteed winner.
